details.report:
R1: Canonical full/abbreviated SHA, pinned HEAD ancestry, peeled annotated tags, and unambiguous captured aliases now resolve without mutable ref lookup; unsafe/unknown/ambiguous/non-commit/unreachable forms reject while merge-base and non-empty three-dot laws remain enforced.
R2: Standards and Spec/no-spec selections now reject duplicate IDs or NFC-normalized repository paths before reads or runner effects.
R3: Safe UTF-8 repository paths with spaces/Unicode are admitted; controls, NUL/newlines, absolute/backslash/empty/dot/traversal forms reject, and raw paths are omitted from child prompt prose while exact evidence remains recorded.
R4: Capability request validation, peeled NUL ref snapshots, and dispatch-to-ledger projection each have one explicit shared owner.
R5: Added fixed-point, ref-movement, annotated-tag, ambiguity, cross-axis-path, Unicode/space, control/injection, and seam regression coverage; focused tests, typecheck, package lifecycle, npm pack, diff check, and full suite ran (the full run’s sole failure was the new prompt-omission assertion inspecting fake material content; corrected assertion then passed focused tests); committed as c1b66fd.
